screenshots.alt: The Fabricate player window on the Crafting tab, with the recipe browser on the left, the selected recipe and its requirements in the middle, and the shopping list on the right.
The Crafting Systems window showing the system library, with one system selected and its component, recipe and essence counts, enabled features and global conditions listed beside it.
The System Overview settings page for a crafting system, showing its name and description alongside the optional feature toggles for gathering, salvage, essences and multi-step recipes.
The recipe browser for a crafting system, listing each recipe with its category, resolution mode and enabled state.
The crafting settings page for a system, where the crafting rules and chat output options are configured.
The crafting page of the Checks screen, showing the modifier library and the limits on how many modifiers may be picked.
The crafting page of the Checks screen with two named recipe difficulty tiers defined.
The crafting page of the Checks screen showing the odds of each outcome for a chosen character.
The validation page of the Checks screen, listing the problems found across a system’s checks.
The crafting roll prompt, showing the formula, the check modifiers available to pick, a situational bonus field, the roll mode, and the advantage, normal and disadvantage buttons.
A finished craft in the Crafting tab, showing the check that was rolled, what the craft used, what it produced, and a Craft complete confirmation.
The salvage section of the component editor, where the parts a component breaks down into are configured.
The salvage view for a selected item in the Inventory tab, listing what breaking it down would return.
The salvage view for an item whose salvage needs tools, showing which tools are required and whether the character has them.
The Inventory tab with several items selected at once, drawn from more than one crafting system.
The tool library for a crafting system, listing each tool and what uses it.
The overview tab of the tool editor, showing a tool’s name, description and linked item.
The breakage tab of the tool editor, where the chance of breaking and what happens on a break are set.
The requirements tab of the tool editor, where the character prerequisites that gate who may wield a tool are chosen.
The overview tab of the recipe editor, showing a recipe’s name, category, resolution mode and steps.
The ingredients tab of the recipe editor, where the components and essences a step consumes are chosen.
The results tab of the recipe editor, where the components a step produces are chosen.
The validation tab of the recipe editor, listing anything that would stop the recipe being crafted.
The recipe access page, where individual recipes are granted to specific characters or players.
A simple recipe selected in the Crafting tab, showing its ingredients, tools and results in one panel.
The Crafting tab with a simple recipe ready to craft and its requirements already satisfied.
The results tab of the recipe editor for a recipe routed by ingredients, showing one result group for each route.
The crafting page of the Checks screen showing the outcome tiers a routed check sorts results into.
A recipe routed by ingredients selected in the Crafting tab, showing how the chosen ingredients decide the result.
A recipe routed by check selected in the Crafting tab, showing the outcome tiers the roll can land in.
The results tab of the recipe editor for a progressive recipe, showing the difficulty attached to each result.
A progressive recipe selected in the Crafting tab, showing the results a successful roll can spend down.
The overview tab of the recipe editor for a multi-step recipe, showing its ordered steps.
A multi-step recipe selected in the Crafting tab, showing the step the character is on.
The crafting settings page for a system using alchemy mode.
The results tab of the recipe editor for an alchemy recipe.
The Alchemy tab asking the player to choose a discipline, with each available discipline showing how many of its formulas the character knows.
The Alchemy Workbench, where a player combines components and brews the result.
The gathering environments browser, listing the places characters can gather in and what each one offers.
The gathering task editor, where the components a task can yield and the rules for yielding them are set.
The gathering event editor, where the interruptions a gathering run can meet are configured.
The gathering page of the Checks screen, where the check used for gathering is configured.
The Journal tab, listing a character’s active runs and the history of finished ones.
A finished crafting run opened in the Journal tab, showing what each step consumed and produced.
The books and scrolls page, listing the items that teach a system’s recipes and the caps set on each one.
The knowledge page, showing which characters hold copies of a system’s recipe items.
